contentText:
Luke Barr / ABC News :

CISA's interim director Madhu Gottumukkala is reassigned as DHS' director of strategic implementation; executive assistant director Nick Andersen will take over   —  The nominee to serve as CISA director has not yet received a hearing.  —  The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) …
